title: Rajasthan RPSC Sub Inspector SI & Subedar Recruitment 2025 Result
postName: Sub Inspector (AP / IB) and Platoon Commander (RAC)
vacancyDetails: 1015 posts: Sub Inspector (AP) 896, Sub Inspector (AP) Sahariya 4, Sub Inspector (AP) Scheduled Area 25, Sub Inspector (IB) 26, and Platoon Commander (RAC) 64.
qualification: Bachelor's degree from a recognized university. Working knowledge of Hindi in Devanagari script and knowledge of Rajasthani culture. Candidates in the final year could also apply as per the notification.
ageLimit: 20 to 25 years as on 01/01/2026. Age relaxation as per RPSC Sub Inspector and Platoon Commander recruitment rules.
applicationFee: General / Other State: ₹600; OBC / BC / SC / ST: ₹400. Pay through the prescribed online or e-challan mode.
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Physical Efficiency Test / further stage → Document Verification → Final Selection
documentsRequired: Roll number or application details, result PDF, marks details, photo ID, educational certificates and documents required for the next selection stage
howToApply:
1. Visit the official RPSC website
2. Open the Results section
3. Download the RPSC SI / Platoon Commander result PDF
4. Search your roll number in the result list
5. Check marks and follow the next-stage instructions
shortDescription: Rajasthan Public Service Commission has released the RPSC Sub Inspector SI and Platoon Commander Recruitment 2025 result. Candidates can check the result, marks and related notices from the official RPSC website.
content:
Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the result for the Sub Inspector SI and Platoon Commander Recruitment 2025 under Advertisement No. 05/2025.

The recruitment examination was held on 05-06 April 2026. Candidates can download the result PDF, marks, disqualified list and objection notice using the official links below.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 10/08/2025
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 08/09/2025
  • Exam Date: 05-06 April 2026
  • Exam City: 25/03/2026
  • Admit Card: 02/04/2026
  • Answer Key: 07/04/2026
  • Result: 19/06/2026
  • Marks Available: 23/06/2026
  • Latest Result Update: 15/09/2026

Application Fee

  • General / Other State: ₹600
  • OBC / BC / SC / ST: ₹400

Vacancy Details

  • Sub Inspector (AP): 896
  • Sub Inspector (AP) Sahariya: 4
  • Sub Inspector (AP) Scheduled Area: 25
  • Sub Inspector (IB): 26
  • Platoon Commander (RAC): 64
  • Total: 1015 posts

Check the official RPSC website and result PDFs for the complete selection and next-stage instructions.
